angle: Builds AdaBoost end-to-end as a hand-computed stump loop of Gini pick, vote weight, exponential reweighting, and resampling rebuild, framed throughout against random forests rather than as abstract boosting theory.
angle_detail: Start at [04:09] for the first stump choice and error-to-vote computation through [09:21], then continue to [10:46] for the weight-update and normalization mechanics. Keep sample weights, the importance of each row, separate from patient weight, a feature the video flags explicitly. Skim the random-draw resampling demo from [15:32] if time is short, since weighted Gini is the shortcut the record notes.
